The '''Commerce Guild Punitive Security Forces''' were the security group that protected the members and assets of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]]. It was merged into the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] when the Commerce Guild joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==History==
{{Quote|Attention, Koro-1 Deluxe Airspeeder. Land and show documentation. Stolen vehicle check. This is the Commerce Guild Army Patrol."<br />"Correction. Owner loaned the vehicle. Please check with owner Teluron Thacker."<br />"Negative. Owner Teluron Thacker reported vehicle stolen. Land or undergo firepower from laser cannon."<br />"Thacker betrayed us. That's why he was so jumpy. Somebody got to him ... Someone he's more afraid of than the Jedi.|Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, en route to the Korriban's Valley of the Dark Lords, responds to the Commerce Guild Army Patrol's order to land his Jedi coalition team's 'stolen' vehicle|<ref name="JQ:TFS">''[[Jedi Quest: The Final Showdown]]''</ref>}}
The [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] employed a force of security personnel and battle droids whose major function was to keep the Commerce Guild's member worlds and systems in line. The organic personnel generally worked separately from the droids, though most of the Commerce Guild's droid forces were commanded and maintained by [[Gossam/Legends|Gossams]].

In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], the Commerce Guild opened an office on the tax-free world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Guild members deserving punishment were sent there. But the Guild motivated other corporations to join them by opening new offices of their own in the Korriban spaceport of [[Dreshdae]]. But by [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], local Guild executives were being robbed in their hotels with alarming frequency by [[Black market/Legends|black market]] thieves, as a Jedi coalition team learned from their Korriban [[Information broker/Legends|informant]], [[Teluron Thacker]]. Using "rampant local crime against Guild workers" as an excuse, therefore, but in violation of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] law, the Guild sent to Korriban a droid army, which it placed in the front ranks of its local officers and [[Troop/Legends|troops]] clad in full [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] armor and battlefield helmets. The droid contingency included [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|''dwarf'']] and [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|''homing'']] [[spider droid]]s. The aim of the Guild's army and security forces on Korriban, beyond protecting the Guild's workers from petty crime, was to crush the local black market, for Guild executives were tired of having to buy back their own items from the thieves who stole them.<ref name="JQ:TFS" />

The Commerce Guild Army and Punitive Security Forces on Korriban also got caught up (surely by the machinations of the Guild with the galaxy's re-emergent [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith]]) in the pursuit of a [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] coalition team (headed by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]) [[Mission to Korriban (23 BBY)|sent]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to track down galactic criminals [[Granta Omega]] and [[Jenna Zan Arbor]]. While the army battled Kenobi and three other [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] within the [[Great Temple (Korriban)|Great Sith Temple's]] long-abandoned [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]], the Guild's local security forces—the '''Commerce Guild Army Patrol'''—led a high-speed chase of the Jedi (whose [[Koro-1 airspeeder|Koro-1]] [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] was piloted by 18-year-old [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]) into the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]], which ended in the scorching demise of each of the patrol's cruisers.<ref name="JQ:TFS" />

This pre-[[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] state of affairs in the galaxy's "cradle of darkness" provided the setting for what was likely the beginning of the corroborative relationship of Guild [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. For, in addition to the ''spider droids'', the illegal new [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|''super battle droids'']] were employed by Dooku's alter-ego Darth Tyranus in fending off the Jedi's intrusion into the Sith Academy. There, the Jedi Master-''turned''-Sith Lord had set up a base for rendezvousing with Omega and Zan Arbor, to establish an 'alliance' with them, which, in actuality, was but a ''cover'' to exploit their uses for his recently established Confederacy of Independent Systems—the [[Palpatine/Legends|Sith]]-backed prelude to [[Clone Wars/Legends|galactic civil war]].<ref name="JQ:TFS" /><ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

During the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Punitive Security Forces maintained their original organizational system; however this was inefficient as the command structures of the various commerce guild armies proved incompatible. Under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the Separatist Army was reorganized around task forces specifically created to achieve particular objectives.

The army was eradicated when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] gave the order to shut down the droid forces. The remaining forces were overtaken and destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Forces==
===Organic Forces===
*'''[[Division/Legends|Division]] (216 officers plus support personnel)''': A [[Division/Legends|division]] consisted of 6 [[Troop/Legends|troops]], led by six security chiefs and a division commander.
**'''[[Troop/Legends|Troop]] (36 officers)''': A troop consisted of six [[Squad/Legends|squads]], including six squad leaders. They were generally led by a single Gossam with the title of security chief.
***'''[[Squad/Legends|Squad]] (6 officers)''': A squad consisted of six Gossam security officers (usually [[Gossam Commandos]]), one of whom acted as a squad leader.

===Droid forces===
*'[[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|''Heavy dwarf spider droid]] unit''': One advanced dwarf spider droid and one squad of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]] or [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2]] battle droids were considered to be one unit.
*'''[[Spelunker probe droid]] unit''': Consisted of five spelunker probe droids. For especially hard targets, a force of 20 units was sometimes deployed.
*'''[[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droid]] unit''': Consisted of four dwarf spider droids. Also organized in forces of 2-5 units.
*'''[[A-DSD advanced dwarf spider droid]] unit''': Organized identically as DSD1 dwarf spider droid units.
*'''[[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droid]] unit''': A single homing spider droid, with four DSD1 dwarf spider droids acting as spotters, operated as one unit.
